title: Senior Software Engineer (Voice AI)
description:
**Senior Software Engineer (Voice AI)**

Location: New York City | In-office

**The Mission**
===============

*“Leading healthcare into the agentic era.”*

Every day, patients call their clinic to schedule an appointment, ask a question, or request a prescription refill. Behind each conversation is a busy healthcare team coordinating people, information, and systems.

Taxo builds Voice AI agents that take on this administrative work. Our agents connect with EHR and practice management systems to help teams handle patient intake, complex scheduling, and refill requests, with reliable workflows and clear handoffs to people.

**The Opportunity: Own the Voice Experience**
=============================================

As our Senior Software Engineer (Voice AI), you’ll report to the CTO and own defined voice-runtime services that make a voice agent useful in a real healthcare conversation. You’ll build and operate speech, turn-taking, interruption handling, tool orchestration, observability, and production fixes for the services you own, while contributing to broader platform decisions with the CTO and engineering team. This is a hands-on role with direct influence on how the product works.

**What You’ll Do**
==================

* **Build the Core:** Build and improve real-time voice agents for healthcare administrative workflows, including intake, scheduling, and refill requests.
* **Connect the Pipeline:** Develop the conversation pipeline across speech recognition, language models, speech generation, and telephony integrations.
* **Get the Conversation Right:** Improve turn-taking, interruption handling, response latency, and recovery when a conversation or external system goes off track.
* **Integrate Deep:** Build voice-agent orchestration and tool calls on shared backend APIs and EHR connectors, partnering with the engineers who own those services and integrations.
* **Measure Voice Performance:** Own voice-component tests and production instrumentation for latency, turn-taking, and tool execution. Partner with the quality engineering team on shared evaluation tooling and cross-product regression coverage.
* **Own Voice Production:** Own voice-service observability, on-call response, diagnosis, and fixes. Use quality findings and rollout feedback to improve live voice behavior.

**The Stack**
=============

We move fast with a modern toolkit:

* **Frontend:** React, Next.js
* **Backend:** Node.js (TypeScript)
* **Data & Infrastructure:** PostgreSQL, AWS
* **Intelligence:** LLMs and Voice AI integration

**Who You Are**
===============

* **The Builder:** Hands-on experience shipping and operating real-time voice AI systems in production, including turn-taking, interruption handling, latency, and recovery from failures.
* **The AI Engineer:** Strong software engineering skills and practical experience with LLMs, agent frameworks, tool calling, and external APIs.
* **The Problem Solver:** Practical experience balancing latency, accuracy, cost, and voice conversation quality in live systems.
* **The Architect:** The ability to debug distributed systems and take ownership of reliability, observability, and testing.
* **The Product Partner:** Product judgment, clear communication, and a track record of moving from an ambiguous problem to a working solution.
* **The Owner:** Careful judgment around sensitive data, access controls, and safe escalation to a human.
* **Bonus:** Experience with streaming audio, SIP/VoIP, healthcare workflows, EHR integrations, or privacy-sensitive systems.

**Why Taxo**
============

Healthcare teams should be able to spend more time on patients and less time on administration. Help us build the products and company that make that possible.

* **Frontier AI Work:** Work on voice agents, real-time inference, tool use, and the hard problems of conversational quality.
* **Impact That Matters:** Build systems that reduce administrative work and make it easier for patients to reach their care teams.
* **Real Ownership:** Take a problem from the first prototype through release, measurement, and improvement.

**Compensation**
================

Base salary: $180,000–$220,000 USD annually

Equity: 0.20%–0.50%

Benefits: Health coverage

**How We Work**
===============

Taxo is a small, fast, high-conviction team. We care deeply about the problem, move with urgency, and take ownership of the work. We collaborate closely, make practical decisions, and keep improving through what we learn from customers.

If you want to build voice AI that works in the real world of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**

SundaySky is a category-defining SaaS platform that enables enterprises and upper mid-market organizations to deliver highly personalized video experiences at scale across the entire customer lifecycle. Built for modern, data-driven teams, the platform empowers marketers, CX leaders and field organizations to transform complex data into dynamic, relevant video communications that deepen engagement, improve the customer experience, increase conversion, and strengthen long-term relationships. Founded in Tel Aviv in 2007, SundaySky serves some of the world’s most recognized banking, financial services, and insurance firms. As the pioneer of AI-powered video personalization, SundaySky reimagines how enterprises communicate. Moving beyond static, one-size-fits-all content to intelligent, adaptive video experiences. The platform combines generative AI, real-time rendering, and an intuitive creation workflow to make personalized video fast, scalable, and measurable. By unifying creation, personalization, distribution, and optimization in a single system, SundaySky enables teams to deliver emotionally resonant experiences that drive outcomes, turning video into a core growth and engagement engine rather than a costly, slow-moving production exercise.

**Investment History**

In July 2022, SundaySky completed a $100 million investment from the private equity firm Clearhaven Partners, providing capital for growth and innovation. This investment completes the transition of the business from a managed services company to a SaaS company, enabling the next stage of growth. Clearhaven is a Boston-based private equity firm focused exclusively on software and technology investments. Founded in 2019 by an investor-operator team with over 50 years of combined experience, Clearhaven was purpose-built to partner with differentiated, growth-stage software companies. The firm invests thematically in high-quality B2B software businesses, supporting management teams seeking an operationally focused partner to drive transformational growth.

**The Opportunity**

SundaySky is positioned in an incredible market for personalized, enterprise video. The company represents an extremely attractive opportunity in a fast-growing market:

* Compelling financial profile
* $25M+ revenue
* 20%+ SaaS bookings growth in 2025 vs. 2024
* EBITDA positive
* 80 FTE globally
* Significant market opportunity
* TAM for Enterprise Video Content Management
* $48B+ TAM with a growing CAGR of 13% by 2030
* 65% of businesses use videos for customer service, 61% of companies use videos for employee communications
* Opportunity to activate moments that matter during the customer lifecycle through personalized video to drive real business outcomes
* Strong Customer Base
* Blue chip customer base in banking, financial services and insurance
* Leading banks and financial service firms such as Bank of America, Schwab, Morgan Stanley, T. Rowe Price, Ascensus, Broadview and Bread Financial
* Health, commercial and property insurance firms including Chubb, Zurich America, Progressive, Liberty, Aetna, UnitedHealth Care, Anthem, Emblem, Kaiser Permanente, and Florida Blue

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across SundaySky's product and platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who can turn ambiguous business and product goals into durable architecture, lead the most complex cross-platform initiatives, and materially improve how the engineering organization designs and delivers software. The ideal candidate combines deep full-stack and distributed-systems expertise with pragmatic judgment, strong product thinking, and the ability to influence through technical credibility. This person will remain close to the code while setting direction across video creation, personalization, rendering, data, AI, distribution, and the shared platform capabilities that support them.

  
Requirements:
  

* Approximately 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including significant technical leadership in production SaaS environments.
* A sustained record of designing, building, and operating complex, business-critical software platforms at scale.
* Expert full-stack engineering capability, with deep experience in modern JavaScript and TypeScript and strong proficiency in at least one backend technology such as Node.js, Python, Java, or C#.
* Advanced experience with modern frontend architecture, preferably React, including component systems, state management, performance, accessibility, browser behavior, and complex workflow-oriented applications.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems, service architecture, APIs, asynchronous workflows, event-driven patterns, background processing, and failure handling.
* Strong experience with relational and non-relational data architecture, schema design, data integrity, migration strategies, and performance optimization.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations involving third-party APIs, identity providers, data platforms, webhooks, file exchange, and event-based interfaces.
* Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS, including containers, serverless services, networking, storage, compute, deployment patterns, and cost management.
* Experience establishing CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, and production-operability practices for distributed applications.
* Strong knowledge of application and platform security, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, data protection, privacy, and secure software development.
* Experience designing for scalability, resilience, high availability, graceful degradation, disaster recovery, and measurable service-level objectives.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize a mature platform incrementally while continuing to deliver product capabilities and protect customer commitments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and implementation across multiple teams without relying on formal reporting authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, tradeoffs, and risks to varied audiences.

**﻿Preferred Technical Experience**

* Experience with video, audio, media processing, creative tooling, animation, rendering, transcoding, or digital asset management.
* Experience with browser-based motion graphics using React, JavaScript, CSS animations, Canvas, WebGL, WebAssembly, or related technologies.
* Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, prompt orchestration, or AI-generated media.
* Experience architecting configurable enterprise platforms and internal developer platforms with reusable services, fine-grained permissions, approval workflows, auditability, and governance controls.
* Experience with high-throughput job orchestration, message queues, event buses, streaming systems, or distributed rendering workloads.
* Experience with enterprise data connectivity, CRM or customer-data platforms, personalized content systems, or customers in regulated industries such as banking, financial services, and insurance.
* Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider.
* Experience with PostgreSQL.
* Experience with automated browser testing frameworks.
* Experience with event-driven systems, background jobs, message queues, or asynchronous processing.
* Experience integrating third-party applications or services.
* Experience working on a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
* Experience in an Agile or iterative product-development environment.

**Principal-Level Expectations**

A successful Principal Engineer should be able to:

* Set coherent technical direction across multiple products, teams, and planning horizons.
* Personally solve the highest-leverage technical problems while enabling others to execute the broader solution.
* Convert ambiguous strategic goals into clear architecture, technical milestones, ownership boundaries, and delivery paths.
* Make consequential technical decisions with incomplete information and clearly articulate the assumptions and tradeoffs involved.
* Recognize systemic risks and architectural constraints before they become delivery or production failures.
* Create durable organizational leverage through platforms, standards, tools, documentation, and stronger technical leaders.
* Build alignment across teams, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and influence decisions through evidence and credibility.
* Balance immediate business needs with scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and long-term platform evolution.
* Raise engineering quality and delivery confidence without becoming a bottleneck or centralizing every decision.
* Demonstrate accountability for the health, evolution, and business impact of the platform as a whole.

**Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $225,000-$250,000 annually

Additional compensation and benefits include an annual bonus, equity, 401(k), medical, dental, and vision insurance, short-term disability coverage, and paid parental leave.

***SundaySky is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Different makes us better.***

  
Responsibilities:
  

* Define and evolve the technical architecture for SundaySky's multi-tenant SaaS platform across frontend applications, backend services, data systems, media pipelines, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
* Lead the technical strategy and design for the company's highest-risk, most ambiguous, and most cross-cutting product and platform initiatives.
* Translate business strategy, product requirements, and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities, sequenced investments, and executable implementation plans.
* Serve as a hands-on technical leader by prototyping critical paths, contributing production code, reviewing high-impact changes, and resolving the hardest engineering problems.
* Establish clear architectural principles, service boundaries, integration patterns, data contracts, and decision records that enable teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary complexity.
* Drive modernization of established platform components while preserving business continuity and the delivery of new customer value.
* Identify and address systemic risks involving scalability, performance, reliability, availability, security, privacy, operability, and maintainability.
* Guide the architecture of video creation, real-time and batch rendering, personalization, animation, media processing, asset management, analytics, and distribution capabilities.
* Shape the responsible use of generative AI, large language models, synthetic media, and AI-assisted engineering tools across the product and development lifecycle.

description:
#### **About us**

Coalition is the world's first Active Insurance provider designed to help prevent digital risk before it strikes. Founded in 2017, Coalition combines comprehensive insurance coverage and innovative cybersecurity tools to help businesses manage and mitigate potential cyberattacks.

Opportunities to make an impact with bold thinking are real—and happening daily at Coalition.

#### **About the role**

This is a Staff-level individual contributor role and the technical lead for the Security Engineering team behind Coalition Control, the platform that helps our policyholders manage their cyber risk and protect themselves from cyber crime. You'll own critical backend services end-to-end, set the technical direction, and be the person other engineers turn to for decisions and mentorship.

We operate more like a Series B startup than a big-company engineering org: small teams, lots of ownership, a strong bias for shipping and iterating, and very little ceremony. Control is evolving fast, with new products like Login Security (protection for policyholders' identities and inboxes, built on Wirespeed) just released as an MVP, and more on the way for new sets of policyholders. We build with AI throughout (Cursor and Claude), so you can just cook.

#### **Responsibilities**

* **Ship product fast:** Work with Product, Design and Engineering to turn high-level goals into iterative plans, shape scope, and build and refine prototypes quickly, contributing across the stack with depth in backend.
* **Strengthen the platform:** Own the technical vision, architecture, and expansion of the backend systems powering Coalition Control (Python/FastAPI, with Go services and a TypeScript/React frontend), and contribute to other Coalition Security Products. Take systems spread across many microservices and simplify them for a saner future.
* **Hold a high bar for engineering craft:** Raise our standards for code, code reviews, testing, and reliability. Use our AI stack to gather context, define requirements, and get code written faster, so you spend your time on the decisions that matter.
* **Unblock and elevate the team:** Lead the Control team of four engineers within a Security Engineering group of up to 15. Guide others through architectural trade-offs, give thoughtful but quick code reviews, and share what you know.
* **Work across lines:** Partner with a wide range of teams and departments, and ramp up quickly into owning many technical decisions and their execution.
* **Share the pager:** Join an on-call rotation across the Security Engineering team (one week roughly every eight weeks, with the team typically paged once or twice a month).

* Proven experience as a backend engineer designing and building distributed, event-driven systems and cloud-based services in production, ideally with tools like SQS or Kafka on AWS.

description:
### **About UseBlocky**

**UseBlocky is a global technology company specializing in Blockchain, Web3, AI, and custom software development. Founded in 2020, the company helps startups, enterprises, and SMBs build innovative digital products, including decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, crypto platforms, mobile applications, and scalable web solutions. UseBlocky combines deep technical expertise with a remote-first culture, empowering teams to deliver cutting-edge products across industries such as fintech, blockchain gaming, DeFi, and emerging technologies. The company is committed to innovation, continuous learning, and creating impactful solutions that shape the future of digital experiences.**

### **About the Role**

**We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Blockchain Engineer to join our engineering team and help design, build, and scale secure blockchain-based products. The ideal candidate has strong experience in smart contract development, blockchain protocols, decentralized applications, and backend systems.**

**You will work closely with product, engineering, and security teams to develop robust Web3 solutions, contribute to technical architecture, and ensure our blockchain infrastructure is secure, scalable, and reliable.**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, test, and deploy smart contracts and blockchain-based applications.**
* **Build and maintain decentralized applications, blockchain integrations, and backend services.**
* **Work with blockchain networks such as Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, BNB Chain, Avalanche, or similar ecosystems.**
* **Review and optimize smart contracts for security, gas efficiency, and performance.**
* **Collaborate with frontend, backend, product, and security teams to deliver high-quality Web3 products.**
* **Participate in architecture decisions and contribute to technical strategy.**
* **Integrate wallets, token standards, DeFi protocols, NFTs, DAOs, or other blockchain infrastructure as needed.**
* **Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code.**
* **Conduct code reviews and mentor junior engineers.**
* **Stay current with emerging blockchain technologies, security standards, and industry best practices.**

### **Required Qualifications**

* **5+ years of professional software engineering experience.**
* **3+ years of hands-on blockchain or Web3 development experience.**
* **Strong experience with Solidity, Rust, Go, or other blockchain-related programming languages.**
* **Experience developing and deploying smart contracts on mainnet or testnet environments.**
* **Strong understanding of blockchain concepts, including consensus mechanisms, wallets, private keys, transactions, gas fees, bridges, and token standards.**
* **Experience with frameworks and tools such as Hardhat, Foundry, Truffle, Web3.js, Ethers.js, Anchor, or similar.**
* **Solid backend development experience using Node.js, TypeScript, Go, Python, or similar technologies.**
* **Strong understanding of security best practices for smart contracts and decentralized systems.**
* **Experience with Git, CI/CD workflows, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.**
* **Excellent problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.**

* **Experience with DeFi, staking, tokenomics, NFT platforms, Layer 2 solutions, or cross-chain protocols.**
* **Familiarity with smart contract audits and formal verification.**
* **Open-source contributions in the blockchain or Web3 ecosystem.**
* **Experience with indexing tools such as The Graph.**
* **Knowledge of zero-knowledge proofs, account abstraction, MEV, or rollup technologies.**
* **Previous experience working in a startup or fast-paced product environment.**

### **What We Offer**

* **Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.**
* **Flexible working environment.**
* **Opportunity to work on innovative blockchain and Web3 products.**
* **Collaborative and growth-focused team culture.**
* **Professional development and learning opportunities.**
* **The chance to make a meaningful impact in a rapidly growing industry.**

### **How to Apply**

**Please submit your resume, GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of previous blockchain projects. We would love to hear about smart contracts, protocols, or Web3 applications you have built or contributed to.**

**Join us and help build the future of decentralized technology.**
